purpose: Clinical research on within-person blood pressure trajectories. Statistics are not enough because we must link repeated measurements within each person over time to estimate individual slopes; pooled averages remove the timing and within-person correlation. All record analysis will remain in the secure processing environment.
question: We request linked diagnosis histories and repeated systolic blood pressure readings, in millimetres of mercury, for the adult hypertension cohort inside the secure processing environment.
definitions: Exclude patients who opted out of reuse.
Use 31 December 2025 as the reference date; age is 2025 minus birth year.
Cohort: adults aged at least 18 with a conditions.icd10 code beginning I10 and at least one systolic blood pressure observation (LOINC 8480-6).
Requested tables: conditions and observations, restricting observations to LOINC 8480-6; retain pseudonymous patient linkage only.
